text.en:
Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Arc Conductor' for 6 seconds.

While Arc Conductor is active, gain <pve 50% /> <pvp [15%] /> Damage Resistance to <arc/>Arc Damage and emit chain lightning around you in a 12 meter radius every 1.5 seconds, dealing <pve 180 /> <pvp [26] /> damage per tick.

Lightning is treated as sword damage.

Buff is removed on stow.

Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Arc Conductor' for 6 seconds.

While Arc Conductor is active, gain <pve 50% /> <pvp [15%] /> Damage Resistance to <arc/>Arc Damage and emit chain lightning around you in a 12 meter radius every 0.25 seconds, dealing <pve 171 /> <pvp [26] /> damage per tick. On single targets, a bonus second tick triggers every 1.5 seconds.

Lightning is treated as sword damage.

Buff is removed on stow.
